sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Procurement of Culinary and Ceremonial Grade Matcha

stage_2.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial board authorization is required; advisory contact: Foreign Investment Business Licensing Board (FIBL), Ministry of Commerce and Trade, Majuro, RMI, for any future onshore activity.
stage_2.operating_license_title: None — a non-resident Marshall Islands business corporation undertaking offshore cross-border procurement and distribution of matcha powder is statutorily exempt from the requirement to hold a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL), a domestic wholesale permit, or a manufacturing/industrial operating license because it transacts no onshore RMI business.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (established under the Environmental Protection Act 1987)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category IV — no environmental impact assessment or environmental permit triggered): the registered activity is administrative, off-shore trading and distribution of packaged, processed organic matcha powder with no construction, land disturbance, water discharge, or emissions-generating process in the RMI. Should the company later establish a physical warehouse in-country, a pre-operational EPA environmental health registration would become applicable, with a full EIA required only for construction of facilities exceeding the EPA thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the current office-only trading model. If a distribution warehouse is established, the operator must: (i) obtain an EPA Waste Disposal/Environmental Health Permit for solid-waste and food-waste handling; (ii) comply with RMI EPA wastewater/water-quality standards for any sanitary discharges, including BOD/SS limits in the RMI Environmental Protection (Permits) Regulations; (iii) maintain ambient fine-particulate and dust levels within EPA ambient air guidelines if any milling/blending is introduced; (iv) avoid VOC/odor emissions by using sealed food-grade containers for matcha storage; and (v) provide secondary containment and approved spill-response procedures for any cleaning agents/solvents.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Office (RTO), Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services, Majuro Atoll; official forms and customs e-services are accessible through the ASYCUDA World customs portal and the Ministry's website at www.mof.gov.mh. Entity incorporation documents are filed with the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney-General.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Non-Resident Business Corporation (BC) must first file Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations, appoint a licensed registered agent, and obtain its Certificate of Incorporation. The BC is then eligible to apply to the Revenue and Taxation Office for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) using the corporate registration certificate and agent appointment letter; however, a Non-Resident BC with exclusively foreign-source income is not statutorily required to hold an RTO TIN. In practice, the entity obtains a Certificate of Good Standing and, where requested by banks or counterparties, an RTO letter confirming no domestic tax filing obligation. If the BC later establishes economic nexus in the Marshall Islands (physical office, employees, local sales), it must register for the Business License regime and obtain a TIN before commencing taxable local activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - A Marshall Islands Non-Resident Business Corporation is classified as tax-exempt with respect to all non-Marshall Islands-source income. No income tax, franchise tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, or stamp duty is levied on foreign-source income of non-resident BCs; the entity is considered fiscally transparent solely for reporting purposes and is not subject to the domestic tax framework unless it elects or is found to have a permanent establishment or local business activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The Marshall Islands imposes no domestic income tax on Non-Resident BCs, so no domestic check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists. Under U.S. federal tax classification, a Marshall Islands Business Corporation is a per se corporation pursuant to U.S. Treas. Reg. § 301.7701-2(b)(8)(i) and cannot elect partnership or disregarded-entity treatment. The only statutory election relevant to the MH_BC is the status designation in the Articles of Incorporation as a Non-Resident Corporation; an annual confirmation of non-resident status is filed with the Registrar of Corporations to preserve the Tax_Exempt_Zone treatment. No OECD hybrid mismatch election is afforded under Marshall Islands law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT or GST. The Marshall Islands operates an import-duty and customs-clearance framework under the Customs and Excise Act, supplemented by an ad valorem tariff schedule on goods entering the Republic. Exported goods are outside the scope of Marshall Islands duty.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no value-added tax or general sales tax regime exists, so no economic-turnover threshold for VAT registration is prescribed. However, any person importing commercial goods into the Marshall Islands must register as an Importer with the Customs Service and hold an Importer's License before the first consignment; the registration trigger is the first import transaction, with no minimum value threshold. A Non-Resident BC that does not bring goods into Marshall Islands territory has no customs registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, QR-code invoicing, or government e-invoicing clearance mandate applies in the Marshall Islands. Customs import and export declarations are filed electronically through the ASYCUDA World single-window facility where operational, with paper declarations still accepted for low-volume consignments. The commercial invoice issued by the organic matcha trader remains the operative fiscal document and must be retained for at least five years for customs audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The concept of 0% export VAT does not apply because the Marshall Islands levies no VAT. Goods physically exported from the Republic of the Marshall Islands are statutorily exempt from customs export duty and are not subject to any domestic consumption tax. An exporter qualifies for duty-exempt treatment on evidence that the goods are genuinely leaving the jurisdiction for a foreign destination, either as outright export or as re-export of previously imported bonded goods within the prescribed transit period. For the MH_BC's actual cross-border procurement model, where organic matcha powder is purchased from a foreign (typically Japanese) supplier and resold directly to a foreign buyer without landfall in the Marshall Islands, no Marshall Islands customs event occurs at all; the transaction is characterized solely as foreign-source income and requires no local export zero-rating claim.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic submission via ASYCUDA World, where the goods physically clear Marshall Islands customs)
Commercial invoice specifying the full value and description of culinary or ceremonial grade organic matcha powder
Packing list with net and gross weights, markings, and container/airway reference
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing international shipment to the destination port
Certificate of Origin or Producer's Declaration for organic matcha re-export transactions
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT payment advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Customs Service may conduct post-clearance audits for up to three years after export and may reassess duties or deny exemptions on misdeclared goods. False customs declarations, under-invoicing, and fraudulent export exemption claims attract penalties of up to 300% of the duty evaded, forfeiture of goods or their value, and, upon conviction, fines of up to USD 10,000 and/or imprisonment of up to five years under the Customs and Excise Act. Any exemption obtained by fraud is void ab initio, and the entire waived duty is retrospectively clawed back with interest. Because no VAT refund mechanism exists, there is no separate VAT clawback exposure; however, the Revenue and Taxation Office retains audit powers to recharacterize income as Marshall Islands-source where domestic nexus is found. The Republic is fully dollarized and imposes no statutory exchange-control repatriation deadline, but regulated financial institutions apply the 180-day inward remittance requirement as an anti-money-laundering control for export proceeds.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands has no conventional central bank or monetary authority; the U.S. dollar (USD) is the sole legal tender. Prudential and licensing supervision of banks is discharged by the Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, under the Banking Act 1995 (as amended), with AML/CFT oversight by the Financial Intelligence Officer pursuant to the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2005.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Because the RMI is in a de facto currency union with the United States and uses USD as legal tender, there are no inward or outward currency convertibility restrictions on either current or capital account transactions. Profit remittance, dividend distributions, and liquidation proceeds payable to non-resident shareholders are policy-free and unrestricted by statute; the only operative hurdles are bank-level AML/KYC onboarding, OFAC/UN sanctions screening, and correspondent-bank due-diligence standards along the settlement chain.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender timeline or mandatory conversion ratio exists for RMI entities. All export receipts, including payments for wholesale trade under ISIC 4631, may be retained indefinitely in USD in any licensed depository account without conversion, repatriation, or earmarking obligations. The functional requirement is purely documentary: banks will expect payment-receipt reconciliation against underlying commercial invoices and bills of lading to distinguish genuine trade flows from round-tripping.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Current Account plus Capital Escrow/Collections Sub-Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Republic of the Marshall Islands Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Treasury Account with Cash Management and Trade Finance Product Access

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. The RMI has no dedicated e-money institution (EMI) or electronic payments licensing framework; any digital payment activity falls under the Banking Act or the Money Service Business registration regime of the AMLA 2005. Offshore digital EMIs cannot obtain an RMI banking licence, do not have access to local clearing rails, and are treated by RMI banks as higher-risk third-party payment intermediaries. Use of such EMIs as a primary treasury vehicle would compromise the entity's Low_Risk_Standard rating; they are acceptable only as a minor collection channel subject to enhanced due diligence.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory. Both Bank of Marshall Islands and Bank of Guam (RMI Branch) require at least one authorized director or signatory to complete an in-person account-opening interview and sign the KYC record at the branch. In limited cases, the interview may be held by secure video conference or at a recognized Bank of Guam regional office (e.g., Guam or Honolulu) if the bank's compliance committee approves in writing; otherwise purely remote opening is not available for a non-resident business corporation. Apostilled charter documents, a certified board resolution, beneficial-ownership statements, and proof of local registered office substance are required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident corporate entity with 100% foreign ownership, tax-exempt status, and no demonstrable local physical operations (typology of shell-company abuse).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing; certified board resolutions appointing authorized signatories; complete beneficial-ownership declaration with government-issued ID; RMI registered-office lease and licensed-registered-agent agreement; practical-substance proof (warehouse or fulfillment arrangements, logistics contracts, trade documentation).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border commodity procurement flows involving high-risk corridors such as Japan, China, or Hong Kong settlement intermediaries (trade-based money laundering typology).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed commercial purchase contracts with each matcha supplier; supplier business-registration certificates and bank references; commercial invoices, packing lists, and air/sea waybills; organic certification credentials (JAS/USDA-EU equivalency); forecast transaction list matching likely SWIFT MT103 debit patterns; pro-forma invoices supporting each projected wire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction velocity and average value inconsistent with the declared low-risk business model, giving rise to suspicion of treasury round-tripping or pass-through financing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cash-flow forecast for the first 12 months; audited or management-prepared financial statements of the ultimate shareholder; a banker's reference from the shareholder's home bank; letters of intent from wholesale customers; inventory and logistics evidence (inspection certificates, receiving reports, customs entry filings).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner resident in a FATF-monitored, sanctioned, or politically exposed jurisdiction, or unexplained wealth indicators.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds evidence (tax returns, bank statements, payroll or sale-of-entity records) covering the initial capital injection; enhanced KYC questionnaire signed under oath; PEP status declaration with mitigating controls; independent professional reference from a licensed attorney, accountant, or registered agent confirming legitimate business purpose.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections must be transmitted by SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's home-bank account directly to the RMI corporate operational account at Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam (RMI Branch), in USD. The wire reason must be stated as capital contribution or general corporate purpose (e.g., purpose code 'COST' or equivalent 'GCR') and must be supported by a certified capital-contribution agreement, board resolution, and an anti-money-laundering source-of-funds questionnaire. OFAC, UN, and local sanctions screening applies upstream and at the receiving bank; funds emanating from banks in FATF-identified jurisdictions may be suspended pending enhanced due diligence.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements to matcha suppliers and logistics providers should be executed primarily via SWIFT MT103 (direct wire to the beneficiary's account) for open-account and payment-on-order transactions, complemented by SWIFT MT202 for cover payments where RMA-supported correspondent networks require separate cover instructions. For larger purchase-order commitments, Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600 issued through the RMI bank's US correspondent network (or via Bank of Guam's full-service trade desk) provide documentary security with presenting banks in Japan and China; Documentary Collections (D/P and D/A) remain a cost-effective capture rail for mid-sized shipments. Each disbursement instruction must be cross-referenced to the underlying commercial invoice and transportation document to survive the bank's AML trade-surveillance check.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/JPY deliverable outright forward contracts (plain vanilla, non-speculative trade-covering maturity) executed through a licensed US or Japanese correspondent bank.
USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDF) traded via an authorized Hong Kong or Singapore dealing bank, given restricted onshore CNY deliverability.
USD/JPY and USD/CNH cross-currency swaps executed under an ISDA Master Agreement with an investment-grade prime bank, limited to hedging of firm committed procurement exposures.
Plain vanilla FX swaps for temporary liquidity relocation between inbound and outbound trade settlements, where covered by bank-approved treasury policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Maritime and Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation; a 60-day grace period applies from the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge on the franchise tax for filing after the 60-day grace period; continued default for more than one year subjects the corporation to administrative strike-off by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations through licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneous with the Annual Report and Franchise Tax filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the registered agent resigns or office becomes invalid without replacement, the Registrar may dissolve the corporation after written notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandatory for a non-resident Business Corporation where all members consent to waive audit and the entity does not meet the public-interest threshold (e.g., listed securities or regulated financial activities). Audit is required if shareholders representing at least 10% of issued shares demand an independent audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial statements, if prepared, may adopt IFRS, US GAAP, or another internationally accepted accounting framework; the Marshall Islands has no statutory local GAAP mandate for non-resident exempt companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under RMI Beneficial Ownership Regulations, the registered agent must maintain a confidential beneficial ownership register. Annual confirmation is required only when a share transfer occurs or when the registered agent requests updated information; there is no standalone public UBO annual return.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3% Gross Revenue Tax is imposed by the RMI Income Tax Act (35 MIRC, Chapter 1, as amended) on gross revenue derived from a trade or business carried on within the Marshall Islands. No separate net-income corporate income tax exists. A Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (BC) deriving no RMI-source gross revenue is outside the tax charge, resulting in an effective 0% rate.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status under the Business Corporations Act confers a de facto full exemption: no tax on foreign-source procurement and resale margins, no capital gains tax, no RMI withholding tax on dividends, interest or royalties, no VAT/GST, and no exchange controls. The only mandatory fiscal cost is the annual franchise tax paid with the Annual Report, assessed on authorized share capital under the Registrar's fee schedule.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Return (Non-Resident Domestic Corporation) under the RMI Business Corporations Act; filed electronically through the International Registry portal operated by the RMI Registrar of Corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before 31 March of each calendar year, reporting the company's position as of 31 December of the preceding year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Corporate Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter the exact name as chartered, any reserved alternative name, and the unique RMI file number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the name matches the Certificate of Incorporation exactly; foreign trading names used for matcha distribution must be separately declared.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name of the licensed RMI registered agent and the physical address of the registered office (P.O. Box alone is insufficient).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A BC must continuously maintain a licensed RMI registered agent; changes require the agent's written consent and a filing within the statutory period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, nationality, and business or residential address of each director.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident natural persons; a corporate director is permitted only if licensed as a trust company or as otherwise allowed by the BCA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: President, Secretary, and Treasurer (or equivalent designations) with addresses; one person may hold multiple offices.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Officers need not be RMI residents; appointing the registered agent or its affiliate as Secretary facilitates service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classes of shares, par value or no-par designation, and the number of shares authorized in each class.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Franchise tax is computed by reference to authorized shares and classes; minimize excess authorized classes to contain annual cost.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of shares issued and outstanding per class, and the aggregate consideration paid or agreed to be paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List the matcha trade's beneficial owner holdings; this section underpins the AML beneficial ownership record held by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the corporation does not conduct any trade or business within the Marshall Islands and derives no RMI-source revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This declaration preserves the 0% effective tax position; a warehouse, delivery route, or sales presence in the RMI would make the declaration false and trigger gross revenue tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of the annual franchise fee based on the authorized share schedule, payable to the Registrar.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment by wire or ACH through the International Registry; the fee range is USD 250-500 depending on the share authorization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director or authorized officer, attesting the correctness of the report under penalties of perjury.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Willful false certification of non-resident status exposes the signatory to criminal perjury sanctions and personal liability for underpaid tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers default penalties and interest assessed by the Registrar; failure to file for two consecutive years results in administrative dissolution, loss of legal capacity, and publication of the strike-off. Reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, a reinstatement fee, and a fresh Certificate of Good Standing. Misstatements are punishable as perjury.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (ESR) under the Economic Substance (Implementation) Regulations 2019; filed through the RMI Registrar's ESR e-filing module (via the licensed registered agent).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 12 months after the end of the financial year; an initial notification of relevant activity is required at the earlier of incorporation or commencement of the relevant activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Select the applicable category, e.g., Distribution and Service Centre Business, or declare 'No Relevant Activity'.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A matcha trader purchasing goods from a connected supplier for resale is within 'Distribution and Service Centre Business' and must complete the substantive sections and the voluntary non-application declaration if all income is from non-connected third parties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B - Management and Direction in the RMI
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provide dates and minutes of board meetings held in the RMI, and the place of strategic decision-making.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Strategic procurement pricing and distribution policies must be directed and managed from the RMI; overseas conference call board meetings require careful factual documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time employees in the RMI, their qualifications, and the physical office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A proportionally adequate local workforce handling matcha procurement logistics is required for a resonated substance claim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Describe the CIGA performed in the RMI: risk management over purchasing and distribution, pricing analysis, inventory management, and control of supplier contracts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Merely booking invoices from a Japanese matcha miller without local CIGA will fail the economic substance test and trigger penalties and international information exchange.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: State gross income, operating expenditure, assets, and connected-party revenue for the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Separately disclose revenue from connected and independent matcha customers; local operating expenditure must be commensurate with the asserted CIGA.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-compliance penalties escalate under the ESR Regulations, including monetary fines and daily default assessments; persistent failure can lead to share cancellation and compulsory strike-off, and the RMI will exchange information with OECD and EU authorities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gross Revenue Tax Return - filed with the RMI Tax Division (Ministry of Finance) only when the corporation derives gross revenue from sources within the Marshall Islands.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within the period prescribed by the Tax Division following each calendar quarter end; no return is required for an entity certified as a pure non-resident with zero RMI-source revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1 - Gross Revenue from RMI Sources
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue attributable to a permanent establishment or trade or business carried on within the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A fully offshore matcha distribution cycle is reported as zero; if a defense advises filing a protective nil return, attach the Certificate of Non-Resident Status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory exclusions and any applicable small-business exemption.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations are not entitled to deductions against gross revenue; the gross measure is the tax base and cannot be reduced by cost of goods sold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 3% tax applied to the gross revenue amount in Line 1.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the entity is later found to have RMI-source activity, the tax is assessed on the entire gross revenue without offset for procurement costs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: A delinquent filing incurs late fees, default interest, and up to a 50% fraud penalty where the omission is non-willful versus willful; officers who certified false non-resident declarations are jointly and severally liable.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation to any shareholder, resident or non-resident. Dividend income is outside the scope of RMI gross revenue tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No RMI domestic withholding tax exists and no comprehensive double taxation agreement covers this entity, so no domestic treaty-relief procedure is triggered. Where a foreign jurisdiction (e.g., a supplier state or customer state) requires treaty-status evidence, the protocol is: (1) obtain a Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar of Corporations; (2) obtain a Certificate of Non-Resident Tax Status / Tax Exemption Letter from the RMI Tax Division; (3) instruct the licensed registered agent to issue a beneficial ownership confirmation; and (4) present the package to the foreign withholding agent to substantiate the entity's non-resident tax-exempt character. Information exchange is governed by the RMI-US TIEA and FATCA IGA; no double taxation relief certificate is issued by the RMI because the entity pays no RMI income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% statutory RMI withholding on cross-border IP royalties - no RMI tax is levied on royalty income of a non-resident corporation. Interest: 0% statutory RMI withholding on cross-border debt interest. No treaty rate reduction is necessary because no domestic withholding is imposed; intra-group interest and license fees, however, must be economically substantiated for foreign TP and ESR purposes.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No RMI statutory transfer-pricing documentation threshold exists; the RMI has not enacted a Local File/Master File regime and the Gross Revenue Tax renders arm's-length adjustments inapplicable domestically. As a practical benchmark for foreign tax defense and ESR compliance, maintain contemporaneous OECD-compliant documentation when connected-party matcha procurement and distribution volumes exceed USD 1,000,000 per annum.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Yes. The Economic Substance (Implementation) Regulations 2019 apply OECD/EU Code of Conduct standards to RMI entities carrying on 'relevant activities', including Distribution and Service Centre Business. A matcha trading entity purchasing goods from a connected party for distribution must demonstrate: (a) direction and management exercised in the RMI; (b) adequate employees, premises, and expenditure in the RMI proportionate to its activity; and (c) performance of core income-generating activities (inventory control, pricing, supplier and distribution risk management) in the RMI, together with an annual Economic Substance Return filing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining only a registered-agent mailbox with no RMI premises, employees or board meetings, while carrying on Distribution and Service Centre Business in matcha powder through connected suppliers, and failing to file the annual Economic Substance Return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties escalating under the ESR Regulations 2019, daily default fines, potential share cancellation and administrative strike-off, and mandatory exchange of information with OECD, EU, and treaty-partner authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certified false ESR statements face personal fines and disqualification orders; strike-off bars named management from serving in any RMI entity and exposes them to foreign regulatory cross-examination.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion in the Beneficial Owner's Residence Jurisdiction
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A U.S. or other resident person using the RMI BC to accumulate matcha trading profits without reporting the foreign corporation (e.g., non-filing of US Form 5471, PFIC/CFC attribution, or undisclosed financial accounts) or without declaring taxable distributions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: US civil fraud penalty up to 75% of the underpayment; willful FBAR penalty up to the greater of USD 100,000 or 50% of the account balance per violation; criminal willful evasion carrying imprisonment up to 5 years and fines up to USD 250,000. The RMI cooperates through the RMI-US TIEA and FATCA IGA.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Veil-piercing available in US tax enforcement where the corporation is an alter ego; personal restitution orders, passport revocation and court-imposed travel bans, and extradition under the RMI-US extradition treaty.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Non-Resident Declaration / Unreported RMI-Source Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying non-resident status in the Annual Report while actually maintaining a permanent establishment in the RMI - such as a matcha warehouse, delivery vehicles, local sales agents, or a dependent contractor taking orders in Majuro or Ebeye.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Back assessment of the 3% Gross Revenue Tax on the entire RMI-source gross revenue for the open period, plus default interest and penalties up to 50% of the tax for willful fraud, and administrative dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The officer signing the false declaration is jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax; perjury prosecution is available and directors may be disqualified from serving as officers in the RMI.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain an accurate register of the ultimate beneficial owner and control persons with the licensed registered agent; structuring matcha payments in cash or split wire tranches designed to evade the USD 10,000 currency reporting threshold; ignoring Financial Intelligence Unit inquiries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the RMI AML framework and the Criminal Code (as amended), consent orders against the registered agent, freezing of corporate records, notice suspension of the entity, and reporting to foreign financial intelligence units.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Money laundering offenses carry imprisonment up to 10 years; directors and beneficial owners face asset confiscation, travel restrictions imposed as bail conditions, and personal civil liability for aggravated penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends to the matcha trade principal while the BC is insolvent or while the distribution exceeds the statutory surplus, including dividends funded by intra-group loans extended by the matcha supplier or by receivables assigned at undervalue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The unlawful distribution must be repaid under the Business Corporations Act; the Registrar may initiate judicial dissolution and an independent liquidator will claw back the distribution as a fraudulent transfer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable to the corporation for the full amount of the unlawful distribution, with only limited contribution rights; foreign insolvency courts may impose director travel bans, asset freezes, and personal recovery orders.
